description: This Java source file defines the `CameraHelper` class, which provides utility methods for managing camera operations in an Android application. It includes functions for selecting optimal video sizes, accessing default cameras (front, back, or any), and creating media files in external storage.

classes.name: CameraHelper
classes.description: A utility class for handling camera-related functions, such as selecting optimal video sizes, obtaining default camera instances, and creating media files.

methods.name: getOptimalVideoSize
methods.description: Selects the best matching video size from supported sizes given view dimensions, maintaining aspect ratio within a tolerance.

methods.name: getDefaultCameraInstance
methods.description: Returns the default camera instance (usually the rear camera).

methods.name: getDefaultBackFacingCameraInstance
methods.description: Returns the default back-facing camera instance.

methods.name: getDefaultFrontFacingCameraInstance
methods.description: Returns the default front-facing camera instance.

methods.name: getDefaultCamera
methods.description: Finds and returns the camera at a specific position (front or back).

methods.name: getOutputMediaFile
methods.description: Creates a media file in external pictures directory with timestamped filename for image or video.
